producer_report.summary: The introspection event's `what` now shows the producer's stored pre-verdict check for each unmet criterion. `event_of_job` passes `candidate.producer_report` to `failure_details`. After the unmet list, a new `pre_verdict_block` shows the producer's status and evidence for each criterion. It lists at most 8 criteria and clips text to 400 characters. A criterion the producer did not list shows "no pre-verdict check recorded". A job with no stored candidate or report gets one line saying so. A passing or missing verification adds nothing. `criterion_key` moved from send_back.rs to introspect.rs as `pub(crate)`, so the send-back and the event match criteria the same way. I added four tests and a CHANGELOG entry that names the root cause.

checks_run.note: 1542 passed, 1 ignored (includes run_pin and send_back tests)

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs: `event_of_job` loads the job's stored candidate and, for each criterion the verification marks unmet, appends to `what` the producer's pre-verdict status and evidence taken from `candidate.producer_report.criteria_check` (clipped with the existing caps). A criterion the producer did not list is shown as having no recorded pre-verdict check. Nothing is added when the verification passed or no candidate/report is stored.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the diff: event_of_job passes job_records.candidate...producer_report to failure_details; pre_verdict_block uses clip(TEXT_CAP) and take(DETAIL_CAP), and writes 'no pre-verdict check recorded' for unmatched. Nothing added for a passing or missing verification (existing exact test passes). For no candidate/report, one line states no check was recorded (follows criterion 3; no status or evidence invented).

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs, in the style of `an_event_carries_the_unmet_criterion_and_the_major_finding`, commits a Candidate whose producer_report marks criterion C as met with some evidence plus a failed Verification with C unmet. It calls `event_of_job` and asserts `what` contains C's pre-verdict status and evidence. It fails on the base tree and passes with the change; check with `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.
criteria_check.evidence: an_unmet_criterion_shows_the_producers_pre_verdict_check passes in cargo test -p athena-core introspect; base never reads the candidate so the status/evidence asserts could not hold (not run on base).

criteria_check.criterion: A second new test covers an unmet criterion absent from criteria_check, and a job with no stored candidate. It asserts `what` states no pre-verdict check was recorded and that the existing assertions on `what` (unmet list, major findings, failed checks) still hold; check with `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.

The root cause is named in the CHANGELOG.md entry (a new entry; docs/decisions.md and records/ are not edited): the self-check was already stored in candidate.producer_report, but the introspection event built in `event_of_job` never included it, so the stage that reports the failure could not see the check.
criteria_check.evidence: New first bullet under ### Fixed in CHANGELOG.md states exactly that; no other doc or records file touched.
